perspective:
Alice Lim’s accessible information:

- She is Alice Lim, a dental hygienist. She and Austin Moreno are old friends who met in high school and have stayed close, often discussing personal and professional lives and supporting each other.
- She noticed Austin had become reserved recently when talking about work. She felt concerned and curious and believed he might be hiding something about his job performance.
- She invited Austin for coffee. She asked if everything was okay at the office. She heard Austin say it was “nothing really,” just “usual ups and downs,” then that he wasn’t sure how to handle a few things at work and that it was complicated.
- After that conversation, Alice believed Austin might be considering a career change because of dissatisfaction at work. She felt worried about his well-being and decided to share her own healthcare experiences and discuss career paths.
- She asked Austin if he had thought about changing careers, saying a fresh start can be good. She heard him say he had thought about it but didn’t know what other paths to take, and he asked what she suggested. She suggested healthcare, offered to tell him more, and offered to connect him with contacts. He said that sounded interesting and he wanted to know more about her experiences.
- She sensed Austin was hesitant about changing careers because of fear of the unknown. She felt frustration and empathy and decided to encourage him by telling him about her friend Lara, who switched to healthcare in her late 30s and was happier. Austin said that was inspiring but he worried about risks and initial struggle. Alice told him that feeling was natural, that growth often comes from stepping out of comfort zones, and that she would support him. Austin thanked her and said it helped to have her support and hear real success stories.
- Seeing Austin’s openness, Alice felt encouraged and hopeful. She offered to connect him with a career counselor and friends in healthcare. Austin said that would be helpful and appreciated the connections. Alice said it was about taking first steps and that she would set up a meeting next week. Austin thanked her and said he looked forward to it.
- After several discussions and meetings, Alice believed Austin was ready to take next steps and appreciated her help. She felt satisfaction and joy. She told him she was proud of the steps he had taken and asked how he felt. He said he felt excited, a bit nervous, and mostly grateful. She suggested regular check-ins. He agreed, saying it would keep him focused and that her perspective was good.
- Alice does not have access to hidden events or Austin’s private thoughts beyond what he said. Her beliefs that Austin was hiding something, was dissatisfied, might change careers, or was afraid are her own observations/inferences, not confirmed facts. She also does not know the specific details of Austin’s work problems unless he told her.
